Description: Susceptible human individuals become exposed through bites by infected mosquitoes.
A fraction of exposed individuals enter the asymptomatic infectious class after the latent period.
A fraction of exposed individuals become symptomatic infectious after the latent period.
Asymptomatic individuals recover at a specific rate.
Asymptomatic individuals can be reinfected through mosquito bites and become symptomatic infectious.
Symptomatic individuals recover at a specific rate.
Susceptible mosquitoes become infected through biting asymptomatically or symptomatically infectious human hosts.

Name: μh
Description: The natural death rate of the human hosts

Name: μv
Description: The natural death rate of the mosquitoes

Name: γ1(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of symptomatic infectious hosts

Name: γ2(a)
Description: The age-specific recovery rate of asymptomatic infectious hosts

Name: βv(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infectious hosts to susceptible mosquitoes

Name: βh(a)
Description: The age-specific transmission rate from infected mosquitoes to susceptible hosts
